chapters.title: Morning Pumpkin Carving
chapters.text: You sat indoors at a large wooden table near a window with a view of trees and buildings. You held a small yellow pumpkin.

chapters.title: Folding a Jacket
chapters.text: You and the caregiver folded a jacket together.
caregiver_facts: The caregiver and he folded a jacket together.

chapters.title: Drawing on the Couch
chapters.text: You sat on a blue couch in an indoor room with large windows, bookshelves, and a green rug. You drew on a magnetic drawing board.

chapters.title: Reading by the Window
chapters.text: You sat in a white patterned chair near a window and a bookshelf. You held and read an open book.

chapters.title: Moving Through the Lobby
chapters.text: You walked near a staircase in a modern lobby. You also stood near a table with a laptop and a tumbler with a straw, looking out at large windows with a view of trees and buildings.

chapters.title: By the Glass Door
chapters.text: You stood indoors near large glass windows and doors overlooking a city and water view. You stood near a doorway while holding a red bag.

chapters.title: Playing with Leo
chapters.text: Your visitor was your grandson Leo; you played with a toy farm together.
caregiver_facts: The visitor was his grandson Leo; they played with a toy farm together.
